strengths: Cache deletion and replacement tests synchronize with active execution and verify subsequent receipt rendering.
Negative cases cover tampering, caller identity, partial context, nonce freshness, record privacy and fallback refusal.
Independent producer tests cover scopes, replies, statuses, cleanup rendering, receipts and plant results while preserving legacy compatibility.
Defect plants target named behavioral assertions and distinguish prerequisite errors from assertion failures.
summary: Reviewed all 370 scoped paths and mapped changed behavior to new and existing tests. No reportable coverage gaps found. Tests and plants were not executed under the read-only restriction.
